170 on intervals is normal for hard work, and intervals are meant to push you up there. The idea of a "fat loss zone" is mostly a myth, though. Lower-intensity work does burn a larger share of its calories from fat, but what drives fat loss is your total weekly energy balance, not the zone you train in. Intervals get a lot done in a short time, easy days build your base, and the best mix is whatever you can keep doing week after week.

I can't say what your max heart rate is or what 170 means for you. Wrist trackers can also drift on intervals, so treat the number as a rough guide, not a verdict. If you have a heart or health concern, take it to your doctor. Want me to look at how your intervals and easy runs are spread across the week?
